verified_measurements.claim: The stint-life target is a competing-risks problem. 1,543 of 5,360 uncensored stints (28.8%) end under safety car, VSC or red flag, and they are far shorter than green-ended stints.
verified_measurements.reproduce: with last_lap as (select stint_id, max(lap_in_stint) L from int_stint_geometry group by 1), endflags as (select g.stint_id, case when g.is_red_flag_lap then 'red' when g.is_safety_car_lap then 'sc' when g.is_vsc_lap then 'vsc' else 'green' end regime from int_stint_geometry g join last_lap l on g.stint_id=l.stint_id and g.lap_in_stint=l.L) select s.is_censored_stint, e.regime, count(*) n, round(avg(s.stint_length_laps),2) mean_len from fct_stint_features s join endflags e using (stint_id) group by 1,2 order by 1,3 desc
verified_measurements.why_it_matters: schema.py frames stint life as single-event right-censored survival (survival:aft). 'Uncensored' is treated as one event. It is not - it is a mixture of a tyre-wear process and an exogenous-interruption process whose components differ by ~2x in mean, and ~4x for red flags.

verified_measurements.claim: features.py::audit_forward_window is blind to aggregation-scope leakage, and BOTH of the programme's known live leakage suspects sit precisely in that gap.
what_the_auditor_detects: _expr_is_forward_looking: a LEAD(), or a window frame with a FOLLOWING bound (ml/src/features.py:221-229)
_self_join_inequality: an inequality between same-named columns under different qualifiers, in a JOIN ON or WHERE (ml/src/features.py:234-265)
unparsed models are returned as violations rather than swallowed (good design)

the_two_suspects.construct: FLOOR(CAST(cm.lap_number AS DOUBLE) / 5.0) * 5.0 AS lap_window (line 76), then GROUP BY race_year, race_id, corner_name, lap_window (line 104)
GROUP BY race_year, race_id then aggregated to one row per circuit_slug, pooling every season. Output grain has no time key at all.

verified_measurements.the_gap_named: The audit detects ROW-REFERENCING leakage and is blind to AGGREGATION-SCOPE leakage. An aggregate whose grouping key carries no time ordering, or whose scope spans the label's future, passes silently. This is a class, not two instances - every int_* model computing a rate, median or baseline by GROUP BY is in it.

findings.title: The stint-life target is a competing-risks problem and is not modelled as one
findings.summary: 1,543 of 5,360 uncensored stints (28.8%) end under SC/VSC/red flag at mean 11.1/17.0/5.3 laps against green's 19.4. The AFT model is told each is a completed tyre life. Stable across all 7 seasons.
what_the_literature_offers: Discrete-time competing-risks hazard at lap grain - cheapest, fits the warehouse grain, unifies with the cliff classifier which is already lap-grain multiclass
Cause-specific AFT: refit treating non-green endings as CENSORED, giving the tyre-limit distribution the app's gauge claims to show. One CASE expression.
Neural Fine-Gray / copula deep competing risks - NOT recommended first, costs the ONNX path
Evaluation must change regardless: cause-specific IPCW-Brier, time-dependent AUC, D-calibration or A-calibration
findings.complication: The censoring is DEPENDENT - SC arrival correlates with race state which correlates with tyre state. Under dependent censoring, IPCW-Brier and concordance are themselves biased. Treatment is copula-based sensitivity bands, not a fix.
findings.honest_counter_argument: From the app's point of view the pit wall's realised decision may be what a user wants. But the current model answers NEITHER question cleanly - it answers the contaminated mixture. Splitting lets the app choose, and int_sc_hazard_history is exactly the term needed to recombine them.

findings.title: audit_forward_window is blind to aggregation-scope leakage; both known live leaks sit in the gap
findings.summary: The SQL-AST auditor catches LEAD, FOLLOWING frames and self-join inequalities. Neither int_corner_skill_residuals nor int_sc_hazard_history contains any of them. The forward reach lives in GROUP BY scope, which the walker never inspects.
findings.why_ranked_second_not_lower: It is the only item in the round that PREVENTS future defects rather than measuring past ones. Cost-adjusted it is arguably first.
findings.the_fix: For every GROUP BY in a model feeding FEATURE_COLUMNS, require the grouping key set to either (a) include a time key at or below the label's grain, or (b) be declared exempt in schema.yml with a written reason. A walker over exp.Group plus a meta property.

findings.title: The prediction band is conditionally miscalibrated on circuit
findings.summary: 72.4% at Mexico to 85.6% at Mugello, 13.2 points across 36 circuits, IN-SAMPLE - while marginal coverage is 80.38% against nominal 80 and tyre-age conditional spread is 1.3 points.
findings.the_fix: Mondrian conformal / CQR recalibration keyed on circuit_key. Does not touch the model - no refit, no contract change, no ONNX re-export. Finite-sample distribution-free guarantee. 36 groups at n>=300 is comfortably enough calibration data.
findings.the_wrinkle: Conformal needs exchangeability and seasons are not exchangeable. Use weighted conformal (Barber/Candes/Ramdas/Tibshirani) or the Gibbs-Cherian-Candes conditional-guarantee framework, which recovers Mondrian as a special case.
findings.must_report: Interval WIDTH alongside coverage. A conformal fix that buys Mexico's coverage by doubling its band width is a real cost the app pays.

findings.title: The stochastic DP over pit timing is ~80% built and never assembled
findings.summary: int_pit_strategy_cost_curve (386,036 rows), int_pit_loss_circuit, int_sc_hazard_history (36 circuits, EB-shrunk, which schema.py records as 'unconsumed today') and the five models are the transition costs, stochastic event process and state dynamics of the published Heine-Thraves DP formulation.
findings.why_it_matters_beyond_a_feature: A DP converts a predictive distribution into a decision, and changes what the models are SCORED on - from pinball loss to expected race time of the induced policy. That gives the p10/p90 arms a job, gives the app a surface, and gives the programme a headroom denominator IN SECONDS OF RACE TIME rather than in pinball units.
findings.note: int_sc_hazard_history's own header says it exists 'so a Monte Carlo race simulator could draw an interruption on each simulated lap.' It was built for this and never wired.

findings.title: 01b should be rebuilt as difference-based variance estimation; three of its five defects dissolve
findings.summary: Estimating irreducible noise without first estimating the mean function IS nonparametric variance estimation - Rice 1984, Hall-Kay-Titterington 1990, and the minimax-optimal random-design U-statistic local-polynomial estimator of Shen/Gao/Witten/Ma (AoS 2020).

defect_disposition.defect_1_m_bias: DISSOLVED as a bug, kept as arithmetic. The (1-1/m) factor is the defining property of the family and is corrected in closed form. work/01's own proposed fix - model d = y1 - y2 as eps convolved with -eps - IS the m=2 difference-based estimator, independently rederived.
defect_disposition.defect_2_one_sided_gate: STILL REAL. The bracket (bias-corrected floor below, leave-one-out kNN predictor's own loss above) has no substitute.
defect_disposition.defect_3_opposite_sign_biases: DISSOLVED. The mean-function bias is handled by smoothing pairwise differences with local polynomial regression at a known rate. There is no d->0 step, so no surviving constant lands in an intercept.
defect_disposition.defect_4_metric: SHARPENED, and becomes binding. See the dimension warning.
defect_disposition.defect_5_d_to_zero_unreachable: DISSOLVED. Nothing needs to reach zero. Measure admissible neighbour distances as a diagnostic, not a go/no-go.

findings.the_dimension_warning: Bayes Error Rate Estimation in Difficult Situations (2025, 2500 MC sims/scenario) found kNN the most accurate non-parametric estimator BUT requiring 1,000 samples/class minimum and 2,500/class at only FOUR features, with all estimators failing as dimension grows. A kNN floor over 33 scaled columns on 82,315 rows is outside the validated regime, and 01b's one-sided gate cannot detect that failure.
findings.the_recommendation: Do not estimate one global floor in 33-D. Estimate STRATIFIED floors in <=3 deliberately-chosen dimensions (compound x lap-in-stint band x circuit - all three already in the mart). Report a floor per stratum with its n. Never pool.

findings.title: e-values / e-BH replace the retrospective BH plan and dissolve 04b
findings.summary: BH assumes a fixed, pre-specified family. This campaign's family was chosen adaptively across 22 checkpoints and stopped when it stopped. Retrospective BH over that produces a number shaped like an FDR statement.
findings.the_answer: e-BH (Wang & Ramdas) controls FDR at alpha under ARBITRARY dependence between e-values. Stopped e-BH (2025) controls FDR at any data-dependent stopping time - exactly the shape of a 22-checkpoint campaign.
findings.why_it_dissolves_04b: 04b asks how to convert a floor-ratio into a p-value - a hard problem needing a distributional assumption and a df on n=5. An e-value is built DIRECTLY from the reseed distribution via a betting or likelihood-ratio construction. No conversion needed. 04b stops being a decision.
two_part_recommendation: Run 04a and 04c as specified but LABEL the output a descriptive audit, not an FDR-controlled statement. 04b becomes a one-paragraph 'why no valid retrospective conversion exists'.

Install an e-value protocol going forward: each arm declares its e-value construction in its leaf doc before running. This is a change to gates.md and is the single highest-leverage change to the programme's epistemics.

findings.title: Monotone constraints are free and answer half of work/05's structural case
findings.summary: XGBoost supports monotone_constraints natively. work/05's argument that a tree ensemble 'spends capacity rediscovering' a monotone physical curve and can produce non-monotone artefacts is an argument for turning the constraint ON, not for changing model class.
findings.consequence: behaviour_audit's monotonicity probe becomes a test of a GUARANTEE rather than a hope. ONNX export unaffected.
findings.must_not: Must not be blocked behind 01. 05a's block is a SHIPPING decision about model class; this is not that decision.

findings.title: Hand-crafted telemetry aggregation is measured to add nothing; signatures and FPCA are the untried representations

options.A_path_signatures: RECOMMENDED. A lap is a path in (distance, speed, throttle, brake, gear, DRS). Truncated log-signature at depth 3-4 over 5-6 channels is ~100 numbers, computed deterministically with no fitting, no training loop, no checkpoint. Reparameterisation-invariant, handles irregular sampling natively. Goes in the transform layer as columns; .bst/.onnx path, parity gate and behaviour_audit all untouched. Testable under gates.md unchanged.
options.B_FPCA: NEARLY FREE. A lap is a curve speed(relative_distance). int_lap_proximity ALREADY cuts each lap into 100 fractions of relative_distance - that is a registered functional grid, and registration is the step that usually sinks FPCA on this data. More interpretable output than signatures, better fit for the publication track 06.
options.C_SSL_embeddings: NOT YET. TS2Vec/T-Rep/TimesURL would likely win on raw predictive power but require a training pipeline, a checkpoint to version, an embedding to export, and they break the 'a feature is a column computed by SQL' contract the transform layer rests on.

findings.title: The published state-space tyre-degradation model exists at ONE-RACE scale; this is the only public dataset that can generalise it
findings.the_paper: arXiv 2512.00640 - Bayesian state-space model, tyre degradation as a LATENT process observed indirectly through lap times, pit stops as state resets, observation equation a function of fuel mass and latent tyre condition, skewed-t for asymmetric driver errors, beats ARIMA(2,1,2).
findings.its_limitation: Case study is ONE driver in ONE race - Hamilton, 2025 Austrian GP, from FastF1. The paper's own stated limitation is that it needs generalising to multi-race, multi-driver.
findings.this_repo_has: 137,447 laps, 8,333 stints, 7 seasons, 36 circuits, with fuel state (int_lap_fuel_state), stint geometry, compound parameters and pit loss all already modelled.
findings.corroboration: The paper reaches for a skewed t; VM-03 measures skewness -0.829 and excess kurtosis 5.218. Two routes, same conclusion.
findings.why_it_is_the_honest_physics: ml_research_program.md section 2 rules out physics VALIDATION and is right to. A latent SSM is not a claim to have measured tyre temperature - it is an explicit statement that the state is unobserved and inferred, with the inference's uncertainty carried through. And the filtered latent state drops into the feature contract as a column, testable under gates.md - which makes this a Tier-2 cost, not a rewrite.

findings.title: GPBoost is a third bracket leg for 01, not just a candidate for 05a
findings.summary: GPBoost (Sigrist, JMLR 2022 / TPAMI 2023) fits y = F(X) + Zb + eps where F is a boosted tree ensemble (LightGBM under the hood) and Zb are grouped random effects, learning trees and (co)variance parameters jointly.
findings.the_inversion: work/05 blocks 05a on 01a/01b because a class change cannot claim headroom not shown to exist. But a GPBoost fit RETURNS sigma^2_stint, sigma^2_race, sigma^2_driver, sigma^2_residual as fitted parameters - a model-based irreducible-noise estimate that fails in DIFFERENT directions from a neighbourhood-based one. It is an instrument for 01, not just a candidate for 05a. A measurement-only probe ships nothing and costs a day or two.
findings.cheaper_first_try: MERF / REEMtree - same idea, less machinery.

findings.title: CRPS should sit beside the pinball trio
findings.summary: Averaged quantile loss over a refining grid converges to CRPS - the strictly proper scoring rule for the whole predictive distribution, in the target's units, reducing to MAE for a point forecast so it is directly comparable to existing baselines.
buys: One number to gate on instead of an ad hoc rule for when p50 clears and p90 does not.
Makes any distributional model directly comparable to the incumbent trio - which they currently are not.

The Murphy / calibration-resolution decomposition splits a proper score into calibration + resolution + UNCERTAINTY, and that third term is an empirical irreducible-difficulty term - an independent read on the same quantity 01b is chasing, from arithmetic on predictions that already exist.

findings.title: FLAG, NOT A RULING: 02a's binary acceptance criterion may not fit its own SQL
findings.summary: 02a asks whether the 5-lap field-median bucket is CENTRED (reaches forward, leaks) or BACKWARD-LOOKING (safe). The SQL is neither: FLOOR(lap_number/5.0)*5.0 is a FIXED BLOCK. A lap at block position 0 is compared against a median including up to four laps that had not yet run; a lap at position 4 includes none. The forward reach is position-dependent within the block and averages about two laps.
findings.scope_discipline: This is NOT a ruling. 02a is the pointer item and running it is the next session's job. This is notice that the item admits a third answer, and that whichever way it lands the fix is likely 'recompute as a trailing window' rather than either branch as written.
findings.action: Correct 02a's leaf doc to admit the third case before running it.

negative_results.evidence: VM-04 - pooled coverage 80.38% against nominal 80, symmetric tails (9.75/9.88), on a target with skew -0.83. The problem is conditional, not marginal.

negative_results.claim: Quantile crossing is NOT available as an argument for distributional regression here.
negative_results.evidence: VM-05 - predict.py:53 row-sorts before writing. The raw rate is unmeasured.

negative_results.claim: The compound-conditional coverage spread is a small-n artefact, not a finding.
negative_results.evidence: VM-04 - HYPERSOFT n=295 at 73.9%, WET n=60 at 86.7%; the four compounds carrying 96% of rows sit at 80.0-81.5%.

negative_results.claim: Do NOT migrate off dbt/DuckDB to SQLMesh.
negative_results.reason: SQLMesh's incremental-by-time-range semantics with explicit @start_ds/@end_ds would prevent some leakage structurally, and its column-level lineage is better. But F02 buys that property directly for a fraction of the cost of re-earning 70 models, a .sqlfluff config, a test suite and a working SQL-AST auditor. VERDICT: the transform layer has NOT been outgrown as infrastructure. It has been outgrown as a REPRESENTATION (F08) and has one fixable hole in its guard (F02).

negative_results.claim: Modern staggered-adoption DiD (Callaway-Sant'Anna, Sun-Abraham, de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille) does NOT apply to work item 07.
negative_results.reason: A safety car is not an absorbing treatment - units are not permanently absorbed into treatment. Worth knowing for 03c's two-way FE where the critique partly bites; not an estimator for the SC experiment.

negative_results.claim: Tabular foundation models (TabPFN v2/2.5, TabICLv2) are an INSTRUMENT, not a shipping candidate.
negative_results.reason: Reported win rates are over i.i.d. benchmark suites, not panels with season-grouped CV and an overlapping 5-lap target whose consecutive rows share four of five terms. No ONNX path; app/public/models/ cannot carry them. BUT as a bounded ceiling probe they are excellent - if a foundation model with no feature engineering cannot beat v11 on cv_final_fold, that is meaningful evidence about what the 33-column contract is leaving.

negative_results.claim: This project's evaluation protocol is AHEAD of the published field. Do not spend to catch up on rigour.
negative_results.evidence: The nearest peer-reviewed competitor (Frontiers in AI 2025, same FastF1 data, 2020-2024, 99,928 laps) wins with a BIDIRECTIONAL LSTM on a forecasting problem - the representation of lap t is built partly from laps t+1..t+9, which is forward-window leakage of exactly the shape audit_forward_window bars - applies SMOTE across a temporal split, and leads with ROC-AUC 0.988 on a 3.5%-positive target. Its own stated limitation independently rediscovers ml_research_program.md section 2's external wall. The gap is model class and assembly, not rigour.

items.title: Extend audit_forward_window to aggregation scope
items.note: For every GROUP BY in a model feeding FEATURE_COLUMNS, require the grouping key set to include a time key at or below the label's grain, or be declared exempt in schema.yml with a written reason. Walker over exp.Group plus a meta property. Converts a silent bug class into a build failure. Source: research/R5 Part 2, VM-06.
items.priority_note: Highest value on a cost-adjusted basis - the only item that prevents future defects.

items.title: Trailing-window / expanding-rate dbt macro
items.note: 02d needs int_sc_hazard_history rebuilt as a season-lagged expanding rate; 02a may need the same for the corner medians. Write it once so the third instance is a call, and so 09a's auditor has one shape to whitelist. Source: research/R5 Part 2.

items.title: Mondrian-conformal recalibration of the degradation band, keyed on circuit
items.note: Hold out a calibration split by season (or by race within season, stated explicitly). Per-circuit conformal quantiles over the CQR score. Report coverage marginally and per circuit, before and after, OUT OF SAMPLE - VM-04's figures are in-sample and are the motivation, not the baseline. Report interval WIDTH alongside coverage. Pre-registered caution: 36 groups were scanned and the extremes reported; the out-of-sample re-measurement is the test. Source: research/R4.

items.title: Monotone constraints on the physically monotone coordinates
items.note: XGBoost monotone_constraints on age_in_stint / lap_in_stint / laps_past_cliff / cumulative_push_load_*. Add-ablation under gates.md; the constraint may not clear its own reseed floor and that is a result. behaviour_audit's monotonicity probe becomes a test of a guarantee. Deliberately NOT depends_on 01 - 05a's block is a shipping decision about model class and this is not that decision. Source: research/R2 Tier 1.

items.title: GPBoost variance-components probe (measurement only, ships nothing)
items.note: Fit y = F(X) + Zb with grouped random effects on stint/race/driver; read the fitted variance components as a model-based irreducible-noise estimate. Third leg of 01's bracket, failing in different directions from a neighbourhood estimator. Never exported, never shipped. Source: research/R2 Tier 3.

items.title: Report CRPS alongside the pinball trio, with the calibration/resolution/uncertainty decomposition
items.note: Arithmetic over predictions that already exist. Prerequisite for comparing any distributional fit to the incumbent trio at all, and the uncertainty term is an independent read on 01b's quantity. Source: research/R1 section 3.

items.title: Assemble the stochastic DP over pit timing
items.note: int_pit_strategy_cost_curve + int_pit_loss_circuit + int_sc_hazard_history + the five models = transition costs, stochastic event process, state dynamics. Published formulation: Heine & Thraves CEJOR 2022. Yields a headroom metric in SECONDS OF RACE TIME. Assembly, not research. Source: research/R6 Part 3.
items.note_2: int_sc_hazard_history's own header says it was built for exactly this and schema.py records it as 'unconsumed today'.

amendments_to_existing_items.change: RESCOPE, not block. Rebuild as difference-based / U-statistic variance estimation, stratified in <=3 dimensions (compound x lap-in-stint band x circuit), bracketed against a distributional fit's closed-form floor. Defects 1, 3 and 5 in work/01 stop existing; defect 2's bracket stays; defect 4 becomes binding via the dimension warning. Source: research/R1 section 1.
CLOSE with a written reason rather than solve. An e-value is built directly from the reseed distribution, so the floor-ratio-to-p-value conversion is not needed. Source: research/R1 section 2.
Run as specified but LABEL the output a descriptive audit, not an FDR-controlled statement. The family was chosen adaptively; retrospective BH over that does not control FDR.

Correct the leaf doc to admit a THIRD case before running: the SQL is a fixed FLOOR(lap/5)*5 block, neither centred nor backward-looking, with position-dependent forward reach averaging ~2 laps. Source: F12.
Report the LEAVE-ONE-OUT connected set size, not just the connected set. The KSS correction is only defined on the former.
Label the output a variance decomposition under an exogenous-mobility assumption, not a causal driver share. In F1 that assumption is strained - good drivers move to good cars because they are good.

Use DML with cross-fitting (DoubleML / EconML) rather than a hand-specified first stage - the conditioning set is 33-dimensional. For heterogeneity use a causal forest AND run its calibration test; the 2025 Int Stat Review methodological review finds systematic misuse in applied work.

ADD an e-value pre-registration step: each arm declares its e-value construction in its leaf doc before it runs, and the campaign carries a running e-BH decision valid however many arms are added and whenever it stops. Source: research/R1 section 2.

noise_floor_and_bayes_error.why: Survey of the difference-based family. Rice 1984, Gasser-Sroka-Jennen-Steinmetz, Hall-Kay-Titterington 1990.

noise_floor_and_bayes_error.title: Variance estimation in nonparametric regression via the difference sequence method

verified: VM-01: 1,543 of 5,360 uncensored stints (28.8%) end under SC/VSC/red; mean length 11.14 (SC) / 5.34 (red) / 17.04 (VSC) vs 19.44 (green). n=8,333 total.
VM-02: stable across all 7 seasons, 19.2-38.9% non-green, length gap present in every season.
VM-03: target skewness -0.829, excess kurtosis 5.218, n=82,315.
VM-04: band coverage IN-SAMPLE pooled 80.38% (nominal 80); circuit-conditional 72.4-85.6% over 36 circuits (13.2 pts); lap-in-stint-conditional 79.9-81.2% (1.3 pts).

VM-04 protocol: production v11 trains on race_year < holdout_season, holdout = MAX(race_year)+1 = 2025 and unpopulated (features.py:115-121); load_scoring_frame scores every lap (features.py:195-213). All coverage figures are in-sample.
VM-05: predict.py:53 row-sorts the quantile trio before writing; parquet crossing counts are uninformative about the models.

VM-06: int_corner_skill_residuals buckets via FLOOR(lap_number/5.0)*5.0 + GROUP BY; int_sc_hazard_history aggregates to one row per circuit across all seasons. Neither contains a LEAD, a FOLLOWING frame or a self-join inequality, so neither is visible to features.py::audit_forward_window.

VM-08: Phase 9 dropped all eleven int_lap_telemetry_aggregates columns as clearing in no family; the only group that ever cleared (proximity) came from a different sensor. Read from schema.py's own notes.
assumed: A-01: that non-green stint endings contribute materially to the 1.9520 AFT NLL headline. Share and length gap measured; loss attribution is 02d's arithmetic.
A-02: that circuit-level heteroscedasticity outside the 33-column contract is the mechanism behind the coverage spread. The traffic/deployment-regime alternative is not excluded.
A-03: that a signature or FPCA representation would clear gates.md where the scalar aggregates did not.
A-04: that monotone constraints will not cost fit. Untested; early-stint warm-up and fuel effects argue against.
